resources.string: After selecting resolver sources, Steam APIs, Store, Community, chat, media and CDN hosts are resolved dynamically on demand without scanning and pinning an IP first.
No resolver sources are currently enabled
No Steam DNS entries cached yet
Entries expire automatically. Clearing the cache makes the next Steam request resolve again.
Coverage includes Steam mobile APIs and service subdomains under steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com, steamstatic.com, steamusercontent.com, steam-chat.com and known Steam CDN host families.
Enabled sources participate directly in live app-scoped resolution. Custom DNS and DoH sources are added to the same selectable list.
DNS and DoH providers can see the public Steam hostnames queried by Monica Steam. Account credentials, Steam Guard secrets, cookies, tokens and chat message contents are never sent to DNS providers.
System DNS, built-in public DoH, and custom DNS / DoH sources are selected and benchmarked together here. Disabled sources do not participate in live resolution or full scans.
Prefer IPv6 when DoH/system resolution returns both families, while keeping IPv4 fallback. Custom UDP DNS currently still queries A records.
Live dynamic resolution off · tap to configure sources
Recommended for everyday use: configure once and resolve automatically without pinning Steam IPs or requiring a scan first.
A separate mechanism: scan and verify current IPs, then write app-scoped Hosts entries. Because IPs are pinned, rescan and apply again when the network changes.
